title: Research candidate
description: One proposed data source, written by the research-sources skill/routine. Evaluation only — never implies implementation.

url.description: Primary official URL (docs or data portal), not a scraper/third-party mirror

gap.description: Which stated gap or hardcoded assumption this addresses

granularity.description: tract | zcta | county | msa | state | national

history_available.description: How far back usable history goes

license.description: Login/key requirement and any usage restrictions found

access_method.description: API, bulk CSV/XLSX download, GIS service, etc.

correlation_results.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py if it was run; null if that tool doesn't exist yet

verification_caveats.description: Claims from web search that weren't confirmed against the primary source and should be re-checked before implementation
